summary: Verified end-to-end that the Resend-based staff invitation email send is now working for the Test Fleet tenant. Backend API (POST /api/tenant/users) returns email_sent=true and email_error=null. Backend log shows 'Staff invite email sent to <email> (id=<uuid>)' for both a curl-driven send and a UI-driven send. UI credentials modal renders the GREEN [data-testid=invite-email-sent] banner with the recipient email and does NOT render the RED [data-testid=invite-email-failed] banner. Regression checks pass: user record is created (visible in GET /api/tenant/users), temporary_password is returned, login_url is returned, DELETE /api/tenant/users/{id} succeeds for cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: Field naming discrepancy vs. review_request: the request stated the endpoint should return 'activation_url', but POST /api/tenant/users actually returns 'login_url' (value: https://quick-wing.com/test-fleet/login). Not a bug per se — the UI modal already reads login_url — but worth confirming naming is intentional and documenting so downstream consumers don't look for a non-existent 'activation_url' field.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Invite email flow is fully working. Backend send path: services/email_service.py::send_staff_invitation_email() -> Resend from invites@send.quick-wing.com (verified domain). If future tests need to verify the RED failure banner, force a failure by temporarily invalidating RESEND_API_KEY — do NOT test with @example.com because Resend rejects it as a hard bounce which is a legitimate email_sent=false path but pollutes real send metrics. Always use pmcxleewalker+<label>@gmail.com aliases. Always DELETE created users after test.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Resend rejected sends because SENDER_EMAIL domain was not verified in the Resend account. Mitigation applied by user (outside this test iteration): (a) verified send.quick-wing.com in Resend, (b) provisioned a working Resend API key in backend/.env. This iteration confirms both fixes end-to-end; email_sent=true and Resend returns message IDs. No further action required.
